nodes.description: Nonsense, frameshift, canonical and deep-intronic splice variants abolish or sharply reduce CFAP44; patient sperm show very weak CFAP44 mRNA, and a deep-intronic variant causes exon 15 skipping. CFAP44 is one half of the tether/tether-head (T/TH) complex, which in ciliates links the I1 inner dynein arm motor domains to the A-tubule of the doublet microtubule; loss of this binding function is inferred from the orthologous complex.
